info.description: Auto-generated from this repo's FE source (src/Common/Api/apis-end-points.js + apis-config.js + src/store/actions/*.js) and API-Endpoints-Server.md. Every backend service exposes exactly one POST endpoint dispatching on the `RequestMethod` field (RPC-over-HTTP, not REST) — see CLAUDE.md/API-Endpoints-Server.md for the full convention. Body is multipart/form-data with `RequestMethod` and `RequestData` (a JSON string). Most methods require the `_token` header (set the `token` collection variable after calling Login) — a short exempt list (Login, RefreshToken, SignUp, etc.) does not. RequestData field names were extracted from the FE source where a literal `Data = {...}` object was found near the call (90 of 241 requests) — the rest ship an empty `{}` template; fill in the real fields per the actual request model.
